questions.question: Which of the following statements is true about veteran nuclear scientist Rajagopala Chidambaram, who recently passed away?

options.text: He played a pivotal role in India’s nuclear tests in 1975 and 1998.
He served as the Director-General of ISRO.
He passed away at AIIMS Hospital in New Delhi.
He was associated with the development of India's first geo-stationary satellite.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**He played a pivotal role in India’s nuclear tests in 1975 and 1998.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Veteran nuclear scientist Rajagopala Chidambaram passed away on January 4, 2025, at the age of 88.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Chidambaram was instrumental in India’s nuclear tests of 1974 (Smiling Buddha) and 1998 (Pokhran-II).**
 
• **He was associated with India’s nuclear weapons program.**
 
• **He passed away at Jaslok Hospital in Mumbai.**
 
• **He was a distinguished scientist contributing significantly to India’s atomic energy sector.**
 
• He served as Principal Scientific Adviser (2001–2018), chaired the Atomic Energy Commission, and was pivotal in shaping India's nuclear and technological capabilities.
 
• He was honored with Padma Shri (1975) & Padma Vibhushan (1999).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Smiling Buddha (1974)__

 __
 
• India’s first nuclear test conducted under the leadership of scientists like Raja Ramanna and supported by Dr. Chidambaram.
 
 
 
• Pokhran-II (1998)__
 
 
• A series of five nuclear bomb tests conducted during Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee’s tenure.

questions.question: Who was the chief priest of Ayodhya's Shri Ram Janmabhoomi temple who recently passed away?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Acharya Satyendra Das.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Acharya Satyendra Das, the chief priest of Ayodhya's Shri Ram Janmabhoomi temple, passed away on February 12, 2025, at SGPGI, Lucknow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Acharya Satyendra Das passed away on February 12, 2025, after being admitted to SGPGI in Lucknow following a brain stroke.**
 
• He had celebrated the first anniversary of the Pran Pratishtha ceremony at the Ayodhya Temple on January 11, 2025.
 
• He was under close monitoring by senior neurologists at SGPGI after suffering a stroke on February 3, 2025.
 
• Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath had visited the ailing priest at SGPGI after his stroke.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Ayodhya Temple__

 __
 
• Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple is a major Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Ram, located in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The temple is believed to be the birthplace of Lord Ram and is an important pilgrimage site for Hindus.
 
 
 
• Pran Pratishtha Ceremony__
 __
 
• Pran Pratishtha is the consecration ceremony in Hindu temples, where the idol is believed to be infused with life force.
 
• This ceremony is a significant event for the temple and the community, marking the idol's installation and worship.
 
 
 
• Sanjay Gandhi Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGI)__
 
 
• SGPGI is a renowned medical institute located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, known for advanced medical care and research.
 
• The institute specializes in several fields, including neurology, and offers treatment and monitoring for critical patients.

questions.question: Who is considered the "Father of Odissi Dance" for his role in its revival in the 1950s, who recently passed away?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mayadhar Raut.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Renowned Odissi dance Guru Mayadhar Raut passed away at the age of 92 on February 22, 2025, in Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mayadhar Raut is credited with reviving and codifying Odissi dance in the 1950s using Shastra-based knowledge.**
 
• He was a founding member of Kala Vikas Kendra in Cuttack, which was the first institute in India to teach Odissi.
 
• Raut introduced Sanchari Bhava, Mudra Viniyoga, and Rasa Theory into Odissi dance.
 
• He was the first to choreograph Gitagovinda Ashtapadis with Shringara Rasa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Contributions to Odissi Dance**__

 __
 
• Revived the Gotipua tradition, a precursor to Odissi.
 
• Founded Jayantika Association in 1959 to codify Odissi dance.
 
• Headed the Odissi department at Shriram Bharatiya Kala Kendra (1970-1995).
 
 
 
• **Other Prominent Odissi Dancers**__
 __
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** - Instrumental in popularizing Odissi globally.
 
• **Guru Deba Prasad Das** - Known for his unique rhythmic choreography.
 
• **Raghunath Panigrahi** - Famous for Odissi music and vocal support.
 
 
 
• **Recognitions**__
 
 
• Padma Shri Awardee.
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (1985).
 
• Tagore Akademi Ratna (2011).

questions.question: Which renowned Odia poet and former bureaucrat, a recipient of the Padma Bhushan award, recently passed away at the age of 90?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramakanta Rath.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Renowned Odia poet and former bureaucrat Ramakanta Rath passed away at the age of 90 on March 16, 2025.**
 
• **He was a Padma Bhushan awardee and served as Chief Secretary of Odisha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Ramakanta Rath was born on December 13, 1934, in Cuttack, Odisha.
 
• He completed his MA in English literature from Ravenshaw College and later joined the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) in 1957.
 
• His notable poetry collections include Kete Dinara (1962), Sri Radha (1985), and Sreshtha Kavita (1992).
 
• He was honored with the Sahitya Akademi Award (1977), Sarala Award (1984), Bishuva Samman (1990), and Sahitya Akademi Fellowship (2009).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ramakanta Rath’s Administrative Career:**__

 __
 
• Retired as **Chief Secretary of Odisha in 1992**.
 
• Held several important positions in **both the state and central governments**.
 
 
 
• **Literary Contributions:**__
 __
 
• Served as **Vice President (1993-1998) and President (1998-2003) of Kendra Sahitya Akademi**.
 
• His poetry has been translated into **English and several Indian languages**.
 
 
 
• **State Honors:**__
 
 
• Odisha Chief Minister **Mohan Charan Majhi announced full state honors for his last rites**.
 
• His last rites will be performed at **Puri Swargadwar after his son's arrival from abroad**.

questions.question: ___________________, the legendary Mumbai cricketer, has recently passed away. Despite never playing for India, he received the Col. C.K. Nayudu Lifetime Achievement Award in 2017 for his contributions to domestic cricket.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Padmakar Shivalkar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Padmakar Shivalkar, the legendary Mumbai cricketer, has recently passed away.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padmakar Shivalkar passed away on March 3 due to age-related issues.**
 
• He had an illustrious career in domestic cricket, taking 589 wickets in 124 first-class matches.
 
• His iconic performance in the 1972-73 Ranji Trophy final saw him take 8/16 and 5/18 against Tamil Nadu.
 
• Shivalkar was awarded the Col. C.K. Nayudu Lifetime Achievement Award in 2017 for his contributions to domestic cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Ranji Trophy__

 __
 
• India's premier domestic cricket competition, where Shivalkar played a pivotal role for Mumbai.
 
 
 
• Bishan Singh Bedi__
 __
 
• A legendary left-arm spinner whose career overlapped with Shivalkar's, which limited his international opportunities.
 
 
 
• Col. C.K. Nayudu Lifetime Achievement Award__
 
 
• Recognizes the contribution of cricketers to domestic cricket, awarded to Shivalkar in 2017.

questions.question: Recently, the internationally renowned folk dance artist Ram Sahay Panday, a Padma Shri recipient, passed away. He represented which folk dance form?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri awardee Ram Sahay Panday, an eminent Rai folk dancer from Madhya Pradesh, passed away at the age of 92.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ram Sahay Panday was a prominent exponent of the Rai folk dance form of the Bundelkhand region.**
 
• He had performed over 100 times across 18 countries, promoting Indian folk culture globally.
 
• **He received the Padma Shri in 2022** for his contribution to traditional arts.
 
• **He mixed Rai dance with Mridangam tunes to create unique and captivating performances.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• He was a resident of Sagar district in Madhya Pradesh and passed away after a prolonged illness.
 
• Madhya Pradesh CM Mohan Yadav lauded his journey of pursuing art despite hardships.
 
• The Rai folk dance, traditionally performed by the Bedia community, gained national and international recognition due to his efforts.
 
• He is survived by his wife and a son.

questions.question: Satya Pal Malik, former Governor of Jammu and Kashmir, has passed away at 79 after a prolonged illness. Apart from J&K, which other states did he serve as Governor?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Bihar, Meghalaya, and Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Ex-J&K Governor Satya Pal Malik Passes Away at Age 79.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Satya Pal Malik**, former **Governor of Jammu and Kashmir**, has **passed away** at **79** after prolonged illness.

 
 
• 
 
He played a key role during the **abrogation of Article 370 in 2019**, which ended **J&K’s special status**.

 
 
• 
 
Began political career in **1970s** with the **Bharatiya Kranti Dal** under **Charan Singh**.

 
 
• 
 
Elected to the **Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly** from **Baghpat** in **1974**.

 
 
• 
 
Held senior posts like **General Secretary of Lok Dal**.

 
 
• 
 
Served **two terms in Rajya Sabha**:

 
 
• 
 
**1980** (first term)

 
 
• 
 
**1989** (second term as **Congress MP**)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Appointed as the **last Governor of the erstwhile J&K state** in **August 2018**.

 
 
• 
 
Also served as Governor of **Bihar**, **Goa**, and **Meghalaya** (till **Oct 2022**).

 
 
• 
 
Remembered for his **decades-long contribution** to both **politics and governance**.
